solution: Rolled back to version 5.1 and later redeployed 5.2 with the config map mounted.
short_description: orders-api 5.2 crash looped due to a missing PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL config map.
trigger: orders-api 5.2 was deployed with a config map that no longer had PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL.
problem_statement: orders-api 5.2 was deployed with a config map that no longer had PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL. The app exits on start when that variable is missing, so every pod crash looped and no orders could be placed.
impact_description: Every pod went into CrashLoopBackOff and no orders could be placed.
immediate_resolution: Ran kubectl -n shop rollout undo deploy/orders-api.

timeline.event: Alert OrdersApiCrashLooping fired. On-call followed SOP-DEPLOY-001 and rolled back.
The release owner, not knowing about the rollback, retried the 5.2 deploy. Pods crash looped again.
On-call read the logs and found "config error: PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL is not set". Told the release owner to stop deploys.
Rollout history showed the variable was dropped in the new revision. Confirmed the cause with the release owner.
Rollback to 5.1 started. Ran kubectl -n shop rollout undo deploy/orders-api.
Pods running and orders flowing again. Closed the incident. 5.2 was redeployed at 19:30 with the config map mounted.

root_causes: The deploy did not mount the new config map, so PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL was missing and the app exited on start.
Neither CI nor the readiness probe checked for required config, so the bad revision reached every pod.

action_items.action: Write SOP-DEPLOY-002 that reads the start up error before rolling back.
Fail CI when a required config key is missing.
Load config before the readiness probe reports ready.
Post every rollback in the deploy channel.
